gifts.title: A real printed menu, so nobody has to scan a phone
gifts.deliverable: A print-ready one-page table menu (HTML page + PDF) built from Pounds' actual dishes named in their own reviews and site — Grail Burger, Blaze It Burger, Te Amo hippie bowl, Piggy Smalls, poutine, ranch flight, dill pickle ranch, wing flavors — formatted to print on 11x17 or slot into a table stand today.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their current official menu page on poundsfargo.com (public, site already returns 200) for exact prices/items; reachable now without login. Fallback: build from the ~40 dish names guests already volunteer in reviews if the live menu page can't be scraped cleanly.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Six reviews across three years say the same thing in different words — one calling the QR-only setup a reason they walked out — and this hands them a finished, printable fix instead of one more note saying 'you should really have paper menus.'

gifts.title: A one-page 'Find Pounds' sign fixing the door confusion
gifts.for_complaint: Can't find the door / confusing address since the move
gifts.deliverable: A single printable/postable page: '6 Broadway N, Fargo — entrance on the right,' an embedded OpenStreetMap static map pinned to the exact building, and the on-street parking note guests already volunteer ('easy parking right on Broadway'). Sized to tape to the small storefront sign guests say doesn't pop out.
gifts.inputs_needed: OpenStreetMap data for 6 Broadway N (already supplied, public, no login) plus the current listed address/hours — both publicly reachable via the OSM tag data and the live poundsfargo.com site.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: This isn't a hypothetical — a 2026 review says guests still can't find the door at the current location, and a 2024 review says the address online doesn't even match. It's the exact confusion, solved with the exact address, ready to tape up before the next Friday rush.
